jia: Quick sync — ran activation-aware SmoothQuant profiling on the 13B-long-context model with 32k context vs GPTQ/INT8. Initial notes:

jia: dataset=LFDialog-32k, eval=ROUGE-L & next-token accuracy, seed=42
jia: AWQ (activation-aware per-channel) reduced memory by ~27% vs fp16, throughput +18% on A100-80GB; perplexity delta +0.6 vs fp16
alex: nice. can you paste the full numbers? small table pls
jia: ```
Model        | Mem delta | Throughput | PPL delta | ROUGE-L delta
fp16         | 0%        | 1x         | 0.0       | 0.0
GPTQ-INT8    | -22%      | +12%       | +1.8      | -0.9
AWQ-IA-INT8  | -27%      | +18%       | +0.6      | -0.2
FP8 (experimental)| -30% | +25%       | +2.5      | -1.4
``` 

maria: where are the regressions coming from? which seq lengths?
jia: most regressions for GPTQ and FP8 concentrated at windows >16k; AWQ holds better on prefix-heavy prompts (conversational turns). suspect outlier activations in MLP layers 4/7/10
kevin: did you try per-layer clipping or activation rescaling for MLP outliers?
jia: yes — small experiment: 1) clamp at 99.9th percentile acts 2) layerwise scale factor computed on 1k calibration steps
jia: result: regressions for GPTQ dropped from +1.8 to +0.9 ppl but still worse than AWQ; AWQ + clipping -> ROUGE diff ~0.0 vs fp16
sam: wow. runtime impact of clipping?
jia: negligible at inference (tensor ops on GPU), one-time extra scalar multiplies during quantization table build. batching unchanged.
ci-bot: :white_check_mark: ci/test-longctx-32k completed: 3/3 suites passed (awq/gptq/fp8)
alex: deployment notes? which to recommend for Dedicated vs Hosted?
jia: recommendation: Hosted default=AWQ-IA-INT8 for lc workloads up to 32k. Provide GPTQ fallback for customers who need deterministic bit-exact outputs (or have eval showing lower regression tolerance). For Dedicated, allow FP8 opt-in for max density but flag as experimental.
kevin: config fields to add to runtime? want to include in rollout PR
jia: suggested flags: `quant_profile: awq-ia-int8`, `fallback_policy: gptq-int8->fp16`, `calibration_samples: 1000`, `outlier_clipping: 0.999`
maria: can we add regression alerting for per-prompt ROUGE drops >1.0 in Optimize?
jia: yes, add eval trigger on new model rollouts + thresholding per-customer promptset
sam: next steps: run longer calibration on LFDialog-32k (10k samples) and run with KV-cache stress test (many small queries with long prefix) — aim to land PR for config + runtime hooks
alex: if someone can run the 10k calibration job tomorrow I can start the PR
maria: i'll queue it on gpu-queue-a
kevin: tagging infra to reserve A100: @eng-infra
jia: ack, thanks all. logging full perf traces to /mnt/bench/sq_awq_13b_32k_2026-03-18.log
